name: traffical/sdk
description: Traffical PHP SDK — deterministic feature flags, experiments, and warehouse-native experimentation. Conformance-tested against the language-agnostic Traffical SDK spec.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: PSR-18 HTTP client for fetching config and sending events
suggest.symfony/cache: PSR-16 shared cache store so PHP-FPM workers share one config bundle
suggest.illuminate/support: Required for the Laravel service provider and facade
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Required for the Symfony bundle integration

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full PHPUnit test suite (unit + conformance)
scripts-descriptions.conformance: Run only the sdk-spec conformance vectors
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run static analysis at the configured level
scripts-descriptions.cs-check: Check code style against PSR-12 without modifying files
